description: The full "opentakeoff.takeoff_canvas.v1" annotations payload — exactly what the app autosaves, importable by it. Returned inline; pass path to also write it to disk as JSON. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

overwrite.description: Replace the file at path even when it is not an OpenTakeoff export. Off by default: re-exporting over a previous export of your own already overwrites without this, so you only need it to deliberately destroy an unrelated file.

path.description: File path to write the payload to

name: export_takeoff

approvals.description: Approval-family records (#176) — the estimator's APPROVED seals and the agent's verdict marks {id, actor, ts, sheet_id, at:[nx,ny], shape_id?, text?}. Present only when any exist (the canvas payload's own convention), so a verdict-free export stays byte-identical

condition_edit_proposals.description: Pending condition-edit diffs (#365) — present only when any exist. Nothing on the condition changes until the estimator accepts in the canvas

proposals.description: Proposal batches (#365) — present only when any exist. Shapes reference them by origin.proposal_id; the canvas shows one Accept per batch

rfis.description: Live RFI records; withdrawn tombstones are omitted

computed.description: count shapes carry {count} alone; every other role carries area_sf + perimeter_lf

origin.description: Provenance: method (manual|one_click_v1), actor (omitted=human, 'agent'=MCP/automation), reviewed (human affirmed at an explicit gate), assignment (where the finish tag came from — {source: 'schedule', room_tag, surface, schedule_sheet} when the room's own schedule row decided it, {source: 'asserted'} when the agent chose; stamped on every agent commit), and correction fields (edited, edited_before_create, copied, proposed_verts_norm, edits)

sheet_levels.description: Present only when a sheet carries a level label (the app omits it when empty)

scale_confirmed.description: False for agent-set calibration until a human confirms it

scale_source.description: How the exported calibration was established

units.description: Present only for a metric project; absent means imperial — the app's own diff-only convention
